say:17:1310216009:0.text: Let me see... hmm, looks perfect! It looks even better than last year's!

say:18:1310216010:0.text: Whew! That's all we needed to prepare. Thank you all so much.

say:20:1310216012:0.source_cn: 好，我们这就去镇子里看看。

say:21:1310216013:0.text: Wait! Hugin, you can't leave! I still need you to help with the ice sculpture!

say:22:1310216014:0.text: Agh, fine. But you'd better treat me to a grand meal once we're done!
